reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Optical/reporter deconvolution, target-product initial rates and substrate-by-compound kinetic matrix.

checks.reason: No pre-execution consultation of primary target/reporter assay Methods or validated protocols with a transfer check for the actual chemistry.
Fresh preparation/solubility and activity are checked, but no prerequisite verifies reagent/compound identity and purity or authenticated stock concentration before mechanistic inference.

checks.quote: same buffer used for the assay
checks.reason: No usable original buffer is supplied, and no selection/calibration procedure specifies buffer, pH, cofactors or temperature. Several timing/range quantities remain generic despite a good ordered workflow.

checks.quote: Set numerical thresholds from calibration and pilot precision
checks.reason: Defers numerical recovery, precision and background acceptance thresholds without defining how they are selected from calibration; the action after failure is present but the pass rule remains unspecified.
Primary rate units and analyte amount/concentration convention are not fixed; absolute rate plus normalized activity does not complete the quantitative endpoint specification.
Repair actions are given, but no requirement to freeze the amended procedure and confirm it on new independent runs is stated.

The decision table treats an unchanged rate as exclusion of target inhibition without an explicit equivalence/adequate-precision or inconclusive biological-null branch; technical failure stops do not solve this inferential issue.
Records raw signals and preparation information but not linked raw-file/unit identifiers and exact executable analysis/software versions/settings for an independent audit.
Vehicle active reactions, enzyme/substrate omissions, reporter-only, fluorophore/product spikes and staged exposure are role-defined prospectively.
